elo_estimate.note: Rough local estimate from Stockfish UCI_Elo handicap games. This is not Lichess Elo, FIDE Elo, or a training target.

protocol.scope_note: External Stockfish benchmark only. Do not use Stockfish moves, evaluations, or game outcomes for McChess training data, labels, distillation targets, or checkpoint selection targets.

dataset.description: May 2026 Lichess standard rated games with both players rated 2000 or higher; human moves and final results only; PGN comments ignored.
dataset.license_note: The Lichess open database is distributed under CC0; see docs/DATASET_PROTOCOL.md.

hardware.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Laptop GPU, 566.36, 8188 MiB

limitations_recorded_before_run: UCI handicap settings are not general FIDE/Lichess ratings.
10 manually chosen opening positions, not a representative or engine-balanced opening corpus.
Results use a different opening protocol and move cap from earlier runs.
Stockfish randomness and one-second search limits are not fully deterministic.
No additional full-strength sanity games in the agreed 200-game schedule.

opening_manifest.history: Games start from saved FENs; preceding opening moves are recorded here but are not in the runner board history.
